status_chip_badge.notes: inline 'live'/'failed' status pills (lines ~168-181), not extracted into a component -- narduk-libs ships no generic status badge either.

empty_state.notes: inline 'No recaps yet' block (lines 129-140), not a shared component; narduk-core ships AppEmptyState but it is not used here.

loading_skeleton.notes: inline `v-for="n in 4"` loop of Nuxt UI's native USkeleton (lines 116-124) -- uses the Nuxt UI primitive directly, not a hand-rolled skeleton component.

error_state.notes: inline Nuxt UI UAlert for fetch errors (lines 109-115) -- native Nuxt UI usage, not hand-rolled.

card_list.notes: the recap feed itself: TransitionGroup of <li>/NuxtLink cards (lines 141-200+), inline in the page, not a reusable component. Same status-pill logic as status_chip_badge above.

form_field_patterns.notes: largest component in the repo; built directly on Nuxt UI's UInput/UButton (no UForm/UFormField schema validation wiring seen in the grepped lines).

timeline_feed.notes: same feed as card_list above -- a live-updating list of recap generation status (streaming/failed/done), arguably closer to a timeline/feed than a static card list given the live status polling (watch() on data.value?.recaps, line 29).

other.notes: domain-specific X/Twitter stream input field, not a lane-target pattern.

notes: Tiny Coolify-hosted app (Dockerfile + docker-entrypoint.sh, not Cloudflare Workers like the other repos in this lane) -- 'Mobile-first X event recaps, posted by agents, read on phone'. No tests directory exists at all in this repo. GET /api/recaps/index.get.ts (server/api/recaps/index.get.ts:1-20) returns the FULL unbounded recap list with no page/limit/cursor/sort params and no enforced limit -- listRecaps() is called with no bound; flagged as a genuine (if currently small-scale) unbounded-list gap, not a UI pattern to extract. The app leans on Nuxt UI's own primitives directly (UAlert, USkeleton, UButton, UIcon) for loading/error states rather than hand-rolling or importing shared wrappers, and renders its list/feed/status-badge patterns inline in app/pages/index.vue rather than as extracted components -- so despite exhibiting card_list/timeline_feed/status_chip_badge/empty_state/loading_skeleton/error_state *patterns*, none of them exist as a reusable local component with a measurable LOC-saved if replaced (all entries above cite the same page file).
